subject: SLA exception request — preview model for Acme AI integration
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SLA exception request — preview model for Acme AI integration

John —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. As we discussed, Acme is planning to run an integration that will call our new "Nimbus-Preview" model (preview release) for a two-week pilot starting next Monday. The preview model is still on a staged runtime (canary kernels + new caching) and our standard Hosted SLA doesn’t cover preview variants.

Request: a temporary SLA exception (uptime and latency commitments) for Nimbus-Preview specifically for the pilot window so Acme can proceed with the integration. Key asks from Acme:
- Target 99.5% availability for the preview endpoint across their region during business hours (PST)
- 95th percentile tail latency target < 450ms for payloads under 2k tokens

We recognize this is outside normal policy — asking internal ops + engineering for a conditional exception and a mitigation plan (fallback routing to Nimbus-1 when thresholds are exceeded; increased monitoring; agreed credit policy if targets are missed).

Timeline: Pilot start 2026-05-17. We need internal OK and signed exception before then. I’ve included Marissa (AE), Michael (runtime lead), and Laura (Revenue Ops) for approvals and next steps.

Attachments: draft exception form referenced below.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, John Doe <john.doe@acme.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SLA exception request — preview model for Acme AI integration

Sergio / team —

Thanks for the heads up. Quick technical read: Nimbus-Preview is running the new KV-cache placement and a couple of attention kernel patches we’re validating. It can be stable for light pilot traffic but we can’t guarantee parity with Nimbus-1 until the next runtime release (ETA 6 weeks).

Proposed conditional exception (engineering):
- Availability: temporary commitment of 99.0% (noted) for pilot window, with a rollback clause if we observe correlated hardware/kernel incidents.
- Latency: commit to 95th percentile < 500ms for payloads <2k tokens under pilot load (we can tune batching but cannot hold to 450ms at full pilot volume).
- Operational mitigations:
  - Automatic routing fallback to Nimbus-1 if 95th > 600ms for more than 10 minutes.
  - Increased sampling and alerting (1-min SLO windows) and a dedicated on-call from runtime for pilot hours.
  - Maintain a warm pool of compatible instances in us-west-2 during pilot.

I’ve attached a short impact workbook with simulation for expected token throughput and cost delta. If Sales/legal need firmer credit terms we’ll need to scope a manual credit formula tied to minutes of downtime beyond the agreed window.

Tagging Laura for process/finance/approval.

-Michael
Michael Grant
Director, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.com

Team —

I’m OK to approve a limited, timeboxed SLA exception for Nimbus-Preview with the following conditions:
1) Exception window limited to 2026-05-17 through 2026-05-31.
2) Engineering (Michael) must enable the automatic routing fallback and 1-min SLO sampling as documented.
3) A clear credit formula is required and must be documented on the exception form. Credit will be capped at a single monthly invoice for the pilot.
4) Acme must sign the SLA exception form and acknowledge the reduced guarantees for preview models.

Next steps for Sergio / Marissa: please populate the exception form (I attached the template), get Acme signature, and route to Legal/Finance for countersignature if required. I’m copying procurement contact on the external thread so they’re aligned.

Approved by: Laura Bennett (Revenue Operations)
